title: Cause and Effect Practice 1
subject: rla
passage:
TEXT A - Cooler Classroom

A classroom on the top floor was unusually warm in the afternoon. The school added reflective film to the west-facing windows. During the next sunny week, afternoon room temperatures were lower even though the air-conditioning schedule stayed the same.

TEXT B - Reminder Texts

A clinic began sending appointment reminders by text. Missed appointments fell the next month. During the same month, a new bus stop opened outside the clinic, making the building easier to reach for some patients.

TEXT C - Mulch Test

Two identical planters received the same amount of water. One planter had a mulch layer and lost less moisture over two days. The mulch shaded the soil surface and reduced direct exposure to dry air.

TEXT D - Loading Order

A bakery van had frequent late departures because its crates were packed after the other vans. The loading crew moved those crates to the front of the staging area. The van then left earlier on most mornings.
